/* Formatted on 8/26/2026 7:00:36 PM (QP5 v5.362) */
  SELECT RAWTOHEX(R.REQUEST_ID)REQUEST_ID,
         R.CONTRACT_SERIAL,
         R.STATUS,
         R.REQUEST_DATE,
         RAWTOHEX(M.MERCHANT_ID)MERCHANT_ID,
         M.MERCHANT_NAME_EN,
         M.CIF,
         M.BRANCH_CODE,
         M.RM_NAME,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN T.TERMINAL_KIND = 'POS' THEN 1 END)     AS POS_COUNT,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN T.TERMINAL_KIND = 'POC' THEN 1 END)     AS POC_COUNT,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN T.TERMINAL_KIND = 'UPG' THEN 1 END)     AS UPG_COUNT
    FROM TALY_BO_REP.MMS_ONBOARDING_REQUEST R
         JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_MERCHANT M ON M.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID AND M.IS_DELETED = 0
         LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_TERMINAL T ON T.MERCHANT_ID = M.MERCHANT_ID AND T.IS_DELETED = 0
   WHERE R.IS_DELETED = 0
GROUP BY R.REQUEST_ID,
         R.CONTRACT_SERIAL,
         R.STATUS,
         R.REQUEST_DATE,
         M.MERCHANT_ID,
         M.MERCHANT_NAME_EN,
         M.CIF,
         M.BRANCH_CODE,
         M.RM_NAME
ORDER BY R.REQUEST_DATE DESC
